failure_modes.detection: forward migration transaction fails or schema contract validation differs
failure_modes.impact: candidate preparation cannot start; live reads remain on legacy generation
failure_modes.automatic_response: rollback schema transaction and mark operation failed
failure_modes.manual_response: review migration evidence before a new independently approved attempt

failure_modes.detection: checkpoint, row count, or rolling manifest hash differs
failure_modes.automatic_response: stop batches and keep generation nonvalidated
failure_modes.manual_response: resume from last verified checkpoint or abandon candidate generation

failure_modes.detection: generation identity or source-row uniqueness constraint fails
failure_modes.impact: affected batch aborts; candidate cannot validate
failure_modes.manual_response: reconcile manifest and loader checkpoint without overwriting existing rows

failure_modes.detection: manifest or artifact hash differs from frozen generation metadata
failure_modes.automatic_response: fail generation and prohibit additional load
failure_modes.manual_response: reacquire or approve a new generation; never mutate frozen metadata

failure_modes.detection: loaded, distinct identity, manifest, or expected baseline counts disagree
failure_modes.manual_response: inspect checkpoint and safe aggregate diagnostics

failure_modes.detection: reader contract or generation schema assertion fails
failure_modes.impact: candidate readers may error or misinterpret data
failure_modes.automatic_response: block shadow comparison or trigger rollback if already switched
failure_modes.manual_response: deploy a reviewed forward compatibility repair

failure_modes.detection: aggregate job aborts, count is incomplete, or generation linkage fails
failure_modes.automatic_response: mark aggregate phase failed and retain transaction candidate
failure_modes.manual_response: repair aggregate job and rebuild the same inactive generation idempotently

failure_modes.detection: shadow valuation, Market Insight, coverage, or status query fails
failure_modes.automatic_response: fail closed and keep live pointer unchanged
failure_modes.manual_response: inspect safe reason code and generation-specific telemetry

failure_modes.detection: comparison yields unexpected value delta, missing data, or schema error
failure_modes.impact: candidate correctness is not sufficiently explained
failure_modes.manual_response: classify and resolve the difference without changing live data

failure_modes.detection: frontend contract version does not support generation-aware backend response
failure_modes.impact: frontend may reject or misstate otherwise valid results
failure_modes.automatic_response: block switch during preflight or rollback if detected post-switch
failure_modes.manual_response: align approved frontend and backend contract versions
failure_modes.rollback_required: yes if active behavior is affected

failure_modes.detection: running backend commit or contract version lacks generation-aware repositories
failure_modes.impact: read pointer may be ignored or inconsistently applied
failure_modes.manual_response: deploy the approved backend and repeat smoke checks

failure_modes.detection: requests report generation mismatch after pointer commit
failure_modes.impact: mixed blue and green results may be observed
failure_modes.automatic_response: trigger rollback; generation selection must not use session state
failure_modes.manual_response: invalidate bounded caches or restart affected backend instances, then verify pointer reads

failure_modes.detection: pointer update transaction fails or post-commit generation IDs disagree
failure_modes.automatic_response: transaction rollback; if commit is indeterminate, fail health until active pointer is verified
failure_modes.manual_response: verify committed pointer and restore recorded prior generation when necessary
failure_modes.rollback_required: when committed state is not the prior pointer

failure_modes.detection: health, golden regions, coverage, valuation, future guard, or Market Insight acceptance fails
failure_modes.impact: users may receive incorrect or unavailable results
failure_modes.manual_response: verify rollback and preserve candidate for forensic analysis

failure_modes.detection: prior pointer cannot be restored or post-rollback verification fails
failure_modes.automatic_response: enter fail-closed maintenance state for affected data surfaces
failure_modes.manual_response: incident owner restores the prior pointer using reviewed break-glass procedure; no bulk row restore
